To adhere or stick to, cling to, attach oneself to; श्यामाथ हंसस्य
 करानवाप्तेर्मन्दाक्षलक्ष्या लगति स्म पश्चात्

; गमनसमये
 कण्ठे लग्ना निरुध्य निरुध्य माम्
To touch, come in contact with; लगितुमिव कृतप्रयत्ना

To touch, affect, have an effect on, go home; विदितेङ्गिते हि पुर
 एव जने सपदीरिताः खलु लगन्ति गिरः Śi. 9. 69.
To become united, to meet, cut (as lines).
To follow closely, ensue or happen immediately; अनावृष्टिः संपद्यते लग्ना
To engage, detain, occupy (one); तत्र दिनानि कतिचिल्लगिष्यन्ति
‘I shall be detained there for some days’. ━II. €10 U. (लागयति-ते)
Adhered or clung to, stuck, held fast; लताविटपे एकावली लग्ना

Clinging or sticking to, remaining on; उवाच रामं संप्रेक्ष्य पङ्कलग्न
 इव द्विपः
Busy with, closely occupied about; परे ब्रह्मणि कोऽपि न लग्नः Skanda P.

The point of contact or intersection, the point where the horizon and
 the ecliptic or the path of planets meet.

The point of the ecliptic which at any given time is at the horizon
 or on the meridian.
The rising of the sun or of the planets.
The moment of the sunʼs entrance into a zodiacal sign.
A figure of the twelve zodiacal signs.

(Hence) A decisive moment, time for action.
